displayDescription: Dusk valley in six parallax depth layers: an idea lamp ignites and a wire lights poles and cottages into a connected system.
styleRenderer: PixiJS 8.22 (WebGL, local pixi.min.js) layered parallax scene
Canvas 2D generated textures (sky plate, stationary star grain, radial glow sprite)
motionEngine: GSAP timeline (local gsap.min.js) at window.__timelines.video: owns composition time proxy and DOM text opacity/y
Deterministic per-layer camera/lighting functions of timeline time using GSAP parseEase
limitations: 2.5D layered parallax only; no 3D modeling, Blender, or physical lighting. Glows are additive radial sprites, not light transport.
Defocus on the near-foreground grass is a static Pixi BlurFilter approximation of depth of field.
Wire sag is a quadratic approximation, not a catenary simulation.

Dusk palette is scene-dependent and chosen from the source-frame review lessons (dark low-value environment with a warm light as luminance anchor); the earlier cream #EFE7D6 canvas is kept only as headline/key text color.
PixiJS initialises asynchronously; frames render once the WebGL renderer is ready and on every timeline seek/hf-seek.
Silent preview: no soundtrack or voice.
